app_store.name: CapitUp: Insurance Organiser
app_store.subtitle: Your policies, in plain words
app_store.promotional_text: Upload a health, life or motor policy and see what it covers, what it does not, and when it renews. Ask questions in English or Hindi.
app_store.description:
CapitUp keeps every insurance policy your family holds in one place and explains it in plain words.

Upload the PDF or a photo of the policy. CapitUp reads it, fills in the insurer, policy number, dates, cover and premium, and asks you to check anything it is unsure about.

What you get:
- A coverage report for each policy: what is covered, what has limits, what is not covered
- Answers to real questions, such as "Will a delivery bill be paid?" or "Is flood damage to the engine covered?"
- Ask anything about your policy, in English or Hindi, with the clause the answer comes from
- Renewal reminders before a policy lapses
- Family members and nominees, so the right people are named on the right policies
- An emergency card with 112, 108 and your policy numbers, one tap away
- Compare two of your own policies side by side

What CapitUp is not: it is not an insurer, broker or agent, and it does not sell insurance. Explanations come from your own document; your policy wording and your insurer's decision always prevail.

Your documents stay private to your account. You can delete your account and all your data from the app at any time.

CapitUp keeps every insurance policy your family holds in one place and explains it in plain words.

Upload the PDF or a photo of the policy. CapitUp reads it, fills in the insurer, policy number, dates, cover and premium, and asks you to check anything it is unsure about.

WHAT YOU GET
- A coverage report for each policy: what is covered, what has limits, what is not covered

- Ask anything about your policy, in English or Hindi, with the clause the answer comes from
- Renewal reminders before a policy lapses
- Family members and nominees, so the right people are named on the right policies
- An emergency card with 112, 108 and your policy numbers, one tap away
- Compare two of your own policies side by side

WHAT CAPITUP IS NOT
CapitUp is not an insurer, broker or agent, and it does not sell insurance. Explanations come from your own document and may contain mistakes; your policy wording and your insurer's decision always prevail.

YOUR DATA
Documents stay private to your account and are used only to give you this service. You can delete your account and all your data from the app at any time. Privacy policy: see the link on this page.
